desc: action's hash pin has mismatched or missing version comment

concrete.feature:
sign:
    name: Sign image
    needs: assemble
    uses: monumental-archive/signer/.github/workflows/sign.yml@0d6c6e297684c8ba401fb9c212532628fe552148 # main
    with:
      image-name: ${{ needs.assemble.outputs.image }}
      image-digest: ${{ needs.assemble.outputs.digest }}
      bundle-artifact: attestation-bundle-image
    permissions:
      id-token: write # the signer mints the Sigstore identity
      attestations: write # the signer persists the provenance
      artifact-metadata: write # the signer creates the storage record

  # The `latest` tag, last (#1280): a name for an index already pushed
  # by digest, gated and signed, applied by the same manifest PUT the
  # versioned path uses. A stream has no release to wait for, so the
  # signature is the last thing before the name; a run that dies before
  # it leaves `latest` on the previous stream image. The tag job for a
  # failed sign does not run, and a failed tag job is a red run with an
  # idempotent re-run.
  # phase: publish
